object.attr: derived: a target from another clone can name a path outside the repository, or a UNC share that makes Windows offer the user's credentials; a target that isn't an object ID names no object (CF-T1). Accepted on 2026-11-10 as a security fix, because the scan of a cloned repository already opened such paths (confirmed in the code); to confirm with the person (open question Q11).
object.description: If a link's target isn't an object ID, Mellon shall report the link as broken without opening a file or folder for the target.
